source: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset via nhdplusTools::get_huc()
processing: Reprojected to output CRS; attributes renamed and converted per crosswalk.

source: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second seamless DEM (current), read via GDAL /vsicurl/
version: 3DEP current tiles: n33w088, n34w088; source dates 20151210 to 20240327 (range across all source projects in the tiles; see dem_tiles_031601130302.csv); vertical datum North American Vertical Datum of 1988; cropped to watershed + 1000 m buffer
processing: Reprojected and resampled (bilinear) to common grid; masked to watershed; no pit or flat filling; elevations keep the source vertical datum (see version); NoData = -9999.

source: USGS NHDPlus HR network flowlines via nhdplusTools::get_nhdphr(), queried in tiles
processing: Reprojected to output CRS; clipped to watershed; attributes renamed and converted per crosswalk.

source: NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access (soilDB::SDA_spatialQuery, SDA_query)
processing: Component K from first horizon with a value; map unit K as component-percent weighted mean of components with K (kwfact and kffact separately); percent of map unit without K recorded; polygons rasterized to common grid (cell centers); masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.

source: NOAA Atlas 14 precipitation frequency grids, partial duration series (PFDS)
version: NOAA Atlas 14 Volume 9 Version 2 (folder se); 2-year ARI; durations 30m, 60m, 06h
processing: Grids read from original zips; NAD83 geographic assigned where the grid has no CRS; cropped to watershed + 2 km; depth (0.001 in) converted to intensity (mm/hr) using crosswalk factors; resampled (bilinear) from ~800 m to common grid; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.

source: LANDFIRE Product Service v2 via rlandfire::landfireAPIv2()
processing: LANDFIRE products requested in output CRS; canopy height converted from decimeters to meters; resampled from 30 m to common grid with nearest neighbor (classed values); masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.

source: LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance (final) via rlandfire::landfireAPIv2(); attribute tables from landfire.gov
processing: Annual codes translated with each year's own LANDFIRE attribute table; LANDFIRE DIST_TYPE values grouped into harvest, fire, insect, and other per 2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv; LANDFIRE SEVERITY labels ranked 1 (low or unburned), 2 (medium or moderate), 3 (high) by their first word, and 0 when the label is not a severity class (e.g. No Severity). Summarized per cell at 30 m: each group keeps its own most recent year, so a cell with insect mortality that later burned has both an insect year and a fire year; dist_last_severity is the severity of the most recent disturbance of any group; dist_count is the number of years with any disturbance. Every source label with its assigned group and rank is listed in the watershed's 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_[HUC12].csv. Resampled to common grid with nearest neighbor; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.
